headline: Brazilian Logistics Firm JSL Reports 36% Rise in Q3 Net Profit
summary: Brazilian logistics and road freight company JSL reported a 36% rise in third-quarter net profit, securing a record 2.8 billion reais in new contracts, even as operational margins experienced slight downward pressure.
why: JSL, a subsidiary of Simpar, is Brazil's largest road freight operator and an indicator of heavy industrial and consumer supply chain movement.

impacts.name: JSL S.A.
impacts.why: Strong net income expansion and record contract signings improve revenue visibility.
